audit.summary: A fully admissible Forced Coordination layout satisfies the stated local accessibility rule but is unsolvable because onions cannot cross the partition to any pot. The printed meta-game also admits a locally stable IPPO/FCP mixture; historical held-out protocol impact remains unresolved.
